idea-plugin.name: Teal
idea-plugin.description:
Teal (.tl) support for IntelliJ IDEA: syntax highlighting, inline diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition (including from a require string to the module's file), type definition, completion, signature help, Find Usages (same-document), and a quick fix that adds the missing require for an unknown global type.

Language intelligence comes from a small language server bundled with the plugin and built on the tl compiler, run through LSP4IJ. It needs Lua and the tl rock installed (luarocks install tl). Syntax highlighting reuses vscode-teal's MIT-licensed TextMate grammar.

server.name: Teal
server.description: The Teal language server bundled with this plugin, built on the tl library. Runs with your lua interpreter and needs the tl rock (luarocks install tl).
